author: ABMN Staff
title: FY2018 Earnings Forecast for Apple Inc. Issued By KeyCorp (AAPL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Sep 17th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Investment analysts at KeyCorp upped their FY2018 EPS estimates for Apple in a research note issued on Wednesday, September 12th. KeyCorp analyst A. Hargreaves now forecasts that the iPhone maker will post earnings per share of $11.84 for the year, up from their prior forecast of $11.80. KeyCorp also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2018 earnings at $2.84 EPS, Q1 2019 earnings at $4.63 EPS, Q2 2019 earnings at $3.07 EPS, Q4 2019 earnings at $3.06 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $13.47 EPS, Q1 2020 earnings at $4.47 EPS, Q2 2020 earnings at $3.17 EPS and Q3 2020 earnings at $2.76 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis.
Several other equities analysts also recently weighed in on AAPL. Nomura set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Thursday. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $205.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. Macquarie set a $214.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, August 27th. Royal Bank of Canada reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, September 11th. Finally, Needham & Company LLC increased their target price on Apple from $220.00 to $260.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Thursday. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating and thirty have issued a buy rating to the stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $217.53.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $223.84 on Monday. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple has a 52-week low of $149.16 and a 52-week high of $229.67. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,086.59 billion, a PE ratio of 24.30, a P/E/G ratio of 1.95 and a beta of 1.33.
In other news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Monday, July 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares in the company, valued at $23,821,566.44. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this link . Also, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Thursday, August 2nd. The shares were sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total value of $4,131,600.00. Following the completion of the sale, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $238,245,202.14. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 378,400 shares of company stock valued at $81,052,754 over the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.

Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide.
